name: wb-tariffs-service
description: Сервис синхронизации тарифов WB (PostgreSQL + Google Sheets)
author: https://github.com/stepaRyazanoff/

scripts.dev:db:up: cross-env ENV_FILE=.env.development NODE_ENV=development docker compose --env-file .env.development up -d postgres
scripts.dev:db:down: cross-env ENV_FILE=.env.development NODE_ENV=development docker compose --env-file .env.development down --remove-orphans
scripts.dev:up: cross-env ENV_FILE=.env.development NODE_ENV=development docker compose --env-file .env.development --profile dev up -d --build --remove-orphans
scripts.dev:down: cross-env ENV_FILE=.env.development NODE_ENV=development docker compose --env-file .env.development --profile dev down --remove-orphans
scripts.dev:logs: cross-env ENV_FILE=.env.development NODE_ENV=development docker compose --env-file .env.development --profile dev logs -f backend-dev
scripts.dev:ps: cross-env ENV_FILE=.env.development NODE_ENV=development docker compose --env-file .env.development --profile dev ps
scripts.prod:up: cross-env ENV_FILE=.env.production NODE_ENV=production docker compose --env-file .env.production --profile prod up -d --build --remove-orphans
scripts.prod:down: cross-env ENV_FILE=.env.production NODE_ENV=production docker compose --env-file .env.production --profile prod down --remove-orphans
scripts.prod:logs: cross-env ENV_FILE=.env.production NODE_ENV=production docker compose --env-file .env.production --profile prod logs -f backend
scripts.prod:ps: cross-env ENV_FILE=.env.production NODE_ENV=production docker compose --env-file .env.production --profile prod ps
